title: fix(spec)!: a single-brace token in a translated flow screen title is refused, like the description beside it (#22627)
body:
Fixes #22627

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

## What changed

The flow engine picks three translated templates in the run's locale and renders each through `renderTextSlot`, the `{{ }}` dialect: a screen's heading (`title`), its body text (`description`), and a refusing `end` node's `message` (maintainer ruling A on #22507, implemented by PR #22626 at `d25b187203`). The `description` and `message` translation leaves ran the one text-slot judge, `textSlotTemplateRefusal`. The `flows.FLOW.screens.NODE_ID.title` leaf was a bare `z.string()`. So `title: 'Welcome, {name}'` parsed, and the heading showed `Welcome, {name}`.

- **`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`.** One package-internal leaf factory, `flowTextSlotTranslation`, runs the judge. `title`, `description` and `refusals.NODE_ID.message` all use it, so one judge covers the three by construction, and the two spelled-out copies of the `superRefine` are gone. It is a factory, so each slot keeps its own schema node as before. No new export. The flows docblock's `⚠️` paragraph that recorded the gap now says both screen keys are judged, and the `title` leaf's comment says so too. The `.describe()` strings are unchanged: the heading's already called it a `{{ }}` template.
- **Pins in `translation.test.ts`, beside the `description` pins.**
  - Refused: `{name}` in a translated title, at the key's path, through `TranslationDataSchema` and `TranslationItemSchema`. The message starts with `TEXT_SLOT_TEMPLATE_REFUSAL` and names `{{ name }}`.
  - Control: `Welcome, {{ record.name }}` and `''` are accepted.
  - Family: every key in `FLOW_SCREEN_COPY_KEYS`, plus the refusal message, refuses `{name}`. A floor stops an emptied key list from passing.
  - Refusal is asserted by the stable prefix and the double-brace spelling, never by remedy wording, so PR #22635's rewrite of the judge's remedies does not flip these pins.
- **ADR-0087.** New D3 semantic entry `translation-flow-screen-title-text-slot-refused` (protocol 18) in its own file, plus the regenerated `migrations/registry.ts`. PR #22635's `18.flow-text-slot-single-brace-refused.ts` is not touched.
- **`packages/spec/dropped-refinements.baseline.json`.** The judge reaches the runtime and not the published JSON Schema, like its two siblings. The 8 schemas that carry the flows face now name the new `flows.valueType.screens.valueType.title` site, and `droppedRefinementSites` goes from 696 to 704. The ledger is hand-edited, and the build printed the corrected entries.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/22627-flow-screen-title-translation-text-slot.md`: `@objectstack/spec: minor`. It is BREAKING (an accept-set narrowing) under the launch-window convention, and it carries the FROM → TO.

No other generated artifact moved: `check:generated` reported all 15 artifacts up to date against the rebuilt `dist`, both before and after the merge.

## The dispatch's premises, measured

1. **The gap was real on `main`.** At `86da194919`, `title` was `z.string().optional()`, `description` ran the judge in a `superRefine`, and the `⚠️` paragraph recorded the gap.
2. **Reach is 0 on the base.** A tsx walker loaded the four bundles that carry a `screens` group, the only four under `examples/**` and `packages/**`: `examples/app-crm` `crm.translation.ts`, `examples/app-showcase` `translations/index.ts`, and `examples/app-todo` `ja-JP.ts` / `zh-CN.ts`. It judged every `flows.F.screens.N.title` string with `textSlotTemplateRefusal`: 8 judged, 0 refused. The positive control, the same walker over `messages` strings, judged 48 and refused 2. Both are `crm.activity.due_today` (`{count}`, en and zh-CN). No fixture or bundle flips.
3. **The empty string stays accepted.** `textSlotTemplateRefusal('')` answers `undefined`, measured. It is pinned for `title` here, beside the existing `description` and `message` pins.
4. **ADR-0087: an entry is owed. This contradicts the triage claim.** `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` refused `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` because the changeset carries a FROM → TO table (evidence `from-to-label`). A breaking narrowing owes the upgrader that rewrite, so the disposition is `registered`, now green: `[BREAKING+clause-②-narrowing] registered translation-flow-screen-title-text-slot-refused (new here)`.
5. **PR #22635.** Its diff of `flow-text-slot-template.ts` (head `3c97f71067`) rewrites the date-macro remedy and the module docblock. It does not touch `TEXT_SLOT_TEMPLATE_REFUSAL` or the plain-path "Write X as Y" remedy, and the pins rely on nothing else.
6. **Consumers.** Each package below was run against a rebuilt `@objectstack/spec` `dist`. Results are in the tests table.

## Ablation (expected direction: red; observed: red)

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` ran on the committed fix (`d3723c736`). It replaced the anchor `title: flowTextSlotTranslation().optional().describe(` with `title: z.string().optional().describe(`. The anchor count went from 1 to 0, and the blob from `62144f762132` to `14fb1e3e3d4f`. Then `vitest run src/system/translation.test.ts` ran: **2 failed | 150 passed**. The failures are exactly the two title pins, the refusal pin and the family pin. The accept-control stayed green, as it should. Restore check: blob `62144f762132` equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The test imports `./translation.zod` from source, so no `dist` rebuild was involved.

## Tests and gates

The head is `327c0cc2fb`: the fix plus a merge of `origin/main` at `5fb1746611`, done with `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`. That merge brought in PR #22635's judge edits. The regenerated `registry.ts` came out byte-identical, `check:generated` reported all 15 artifacts current, and the branch delta against `origin/main` is exactly this PR's 6 files.

**Other checks.**

- **CLI integration tier.** Left to CI: this diff touches no CLI file and no spawn entry. Three i18n files are in that tier: `i18n-extract-check-dry-run`, `-check-json` and `-companion-orphan`.
- **Reach after the merge.** Re-measured at `327c0cc2fb` with the judge as it now stands: 8 screen headings judged, 0 refused. The control refused 2 of 48 messages.
- **Gates.**
  - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths) derived the same 92 commands before and after the merge. All 92 were run at `327c0cc2fb`, and all 92 exited 0.
  - `--ran` reconciliation: `92 derived, 92 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`, a derived zero with every exit code recorded.
  - The first run, at `cf08a125a`, had three PREREQUISITE NOT MET refusals (exit 3), which measure nothing: a shallow clone missing `check-plugin-teardown-shape`'s pinned fixture commit, and unbuilt packages for `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-walk-parity`. All three were re-run green once their inputs existed.
- **The families the PM named are all in that set.**
  - Repo scripts: `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-closing-keyword-parity`, `check-spec-docblock-symbol-anchors` and `docs-audit/check-affected-docs`.
  - The spec package's checks: `check:api-surface`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:docs`, `check:liveness`, `check:strictness-ledger`, `check:export-origins` and `check:objectui-pin-citations`.
  - Root checks: `check:i18n-walk-parity`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:issue-citations` and `check:spec-parsed-alias`.

## Acceptance notes

- **The #22507 changeset still says the opposite, in the same release.** `.changeset/22507-screen-copy-engine-pick-spec.md` (PR #22626, unreleased) ends with "A translated screen `title` is not judged by the text-slot rule yet". This PR's changeset carries the repo's usual sentence for that case ("An earlier entry in this release says …; that describes the face before this change"). The other file was outside this card's file surface, so it was not edited. If deleting that last bullet reads better in the compiled CHANGELOG, it is a one-line follow-up.
- **The engine docblock still hedges.** `AutomationEngine.renderFlowTextSlot` in `packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts` says the single brace is refused "for the keys that judge covers". That is still true, and the judge now covers all three keys, so the hedge could go. Not edited (outside the surface).
- **A translated heading is judged even when it stands in for the node label.** When a screen declares no `config.title`, the heading falls back to `node.label`, which is plain text and never judged on the source. Its translation is still judged, because the engine renders whatever it picks through `renderTextSlot`. The docblock says so.
- **The prose docs are already correct.** The `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` flows bullets already say a translation keeps the holes of the text it translates, and nothing there is made false. The generated `references/system/translation.mdx` did not move.
